Every vessel the compositor maps is entered into the
ledger — a strict ordering of windows per orbit. Layouts
never move windows; they project the ledger onto the
Because the projection is pure, undo is trivial: restoring
an earlier ledger restores the exact screen, gaps and all.
A layout is therefore not a mode the window manager is
in. It is a function of three arguments, and it is total:
every window in the ledger receives exactly one rectangle,
and the rectangles sum to the workarea with nothing over.
